body:
## ⚔️ Apex SMP Classes Plugin ⚔️

Rise above the rest and prove you're worthy of the Apex.

The Apex SMP Classes Plugin introduces unique classes that grant powerful abilities, game-changing passives, and balanced weaknesses. Every choice matters as players build alliances, wage wars, and fight for dominance.

## 9 Unique Classes
- Assasin
- Tank
- Hunter
- Gladiator
- Frost
- Vampire
- Guardian
- Midas
- Pyromancer

## Want to learn more about each kit?

Join the server with the plugin installed and use **_/kit_** in chat. You'll see a full breakdown of your selected kit's buffs, abilities, and weaknesses.

Server operators can also use **_/adminkit_** to directly select and assign specific classes for testing, events, or administration purposes.

## The 10th Class
gather all 9 essences by killing every single Class to craft the **_APEX_** Class. Apex class is a combonation of all 9 Classes. now, i know what your thinking "cant it just be farmed?" thats why we have added the **_LIMIT_** of **_TWO_** Apex classes. this will make it more worth it to try and get it fast!

# CLASS RE-ROLL
![KIT REROLL TOKEN](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f9a42e90a564c2f4ffa6415c3a16a52b49de2c1.png)

## This plugin is perfect for :
- SMP servers
- Hardcore SMP's
- PVP events
- Factions
- Community Servers

## Why download Apex SMP?
most smps eventually feel repetitive, get max gear, form teams, fight. Apex Smp changes that, By giving every player a unique role through its Class system

With 9 different classes, every fight, alliance, and rivalry feel different.

If **_YOU_**, yes you. would like to join the **_OFFICIAL_** Apex smp, join our discord and apply to be a member!
